correctness.rationale: Spherical harmonic decomposition h=α+a·u+Q_2+C_3 separates even second-mode and odd third-mode constraints. Three coordinate circular shadows force traceless Q_2=0 and C_3=c xyz by solving six planar coefficients and Laplace constraints. On the diagonal plane xyz=sin(3θ)/(3√6), giving T3=|c|/(3√6); the coordinate-triple maximum |xyz|=1/(3√3) yields exact Hausdorff residual. Averaging signed diagonal maximizing quartets establishes R and center a as unique minimax ball. Any three planes impose at most six third-harmonic equations on dimension-7 H3, allowing a nonzero sufficiently small strictly convex nonball with disk shadows. Checked actual rational linear rank script and independently symbolic diagonal Fourier identity; these finite tests corroborate the algebraic all-parameter proof.
